c74object.name: evi_overdrive_wrap
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Anti-aliased atan-based saturation with shape input to control overdrive and gain wrapping
c74object.description:
evi_overdrive_wrap is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_overdrive_wrap.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_saturators.genexpr
evi_overdrive_wrap is also available in MSP as: evi.overdrive.wrap~.
This atan() overdrive is a simple but deluxe memoryless nonlinear processor with atan() gain wrapping around it's core nonlinearity (controlled via inlet 2) and various anti-aliasing options. The object can be driven very hard and maintains stability and clean/dirty sound.

geninlet.name: input
geninlet.digest: Signal. Audio input to be overdriven.

geninlet.name: shape
geninlet.digest: (linear gain 1..100) @default 1 @min 1 @max 100. Linear gain 1..100 (0..40 dB). This actually controls a reciprocal gain wrapping around the internal saturator. The object handles high gain very well with minimal aliasing. This inlet corresponds to the equivalent inlet of the MSP 'overdrive~' object.

attribute.name: aa
attribute.description: The 'aa' ('Anti-Aliasing) method used. 0=Adaa1, 1=Adaa1 2x oversampled, 2=Adaa1 4x oversampled, 3=Adaa2 (default), 4=Adaa2 2x oversampled, 5=Adaa2 4x oversampled. 0..5 does not necessarily mean increasing in quality, it really depends on your audio input material. Experimentation is encouraged.

attribute.name: hfcompensate
attribute.description: The object provides a high frequency compensation 'decorelation' filter on its output for restoring the reduced high frequency response that can occur with this type of anti-aliasing, especially when utilising the oversampling options (as opposed to just using pure 'adaa'). Experiment with turning this on to improve high frequencies (default on).
